name: testland/multi-tool-finding-triage
description: Merges two or more security scanner reports into one gate. Use when triaging or merging findings from two or more security scanners and you need a single BLOCK or PASS decision instead of reading N separate reports. Normalizes each report into one common finding format (a canonical `Finding`), deduplicates on a per-domain key while recording which scanners agree (`caught_by` multi-scanner consensus), validates a waiver (finding-suppression) file, rejecting any missing `expires:` / `approved_by:` / `reason:` or expired, enriches CVE findings with EPSS (exploit-probability score) and CISA KEV (the known-exploited-vulnerabilities catalog), then applies a `fail_on` severity threshold to emit BLOCK or PASS plus a bucketed pull-request comment. Works across static (SAST), dynamic web (DAST), secret, dependency (SCA), container, and IaC (infrastructure-as-code) scanners. To run or configure a single scanner instead, use semgrep-rules, codeql-queries, bandit-python, or gosec-go; this runs after them to merge output - the cross-scanner gate, not a single-scanner wrapper.
